shorts.title: The periodic table's empty chairs
shorts.description:
The periodic table started with empty chairs — gaps Mendeleev left for metals that did not exist yet.

shorts.title: Why tellurium sat before iodine
shorts.description:
Tellurium is heavier than iodine — and still sits before it. The table was following chemistry, not the scale.
